question: What coverings succeed the will-covering in the upward sequence?
premises: Above the will-covering is a covering named the awakened one.
The awakened covering is frequented by the eight directional Rudras.
Above the awakened covering lies the great covenant-covering.
inference: The sequence rises from the will-covering to the awakened covering and then to the great covenant-covering.
plain_english: Above the will-covering is the one called the awakened covering, frequented by the eight directional Rudras. Above the awakened covering lies the great covenant-covering.
